Container.Name: guncad-mirror
Container.Overview: GunCAD Mirror acquires LBRY releases selected by GunCAD Index API v2, verifies their plaintext checksums, generates BitTorrent files, adds them to qBittorrent at the assembled files' existing paths, and can publish authenticated torrent evidence back to Index.
Container.Requires: Persist /data. This single-container template does not install qBittorrent. Before enabling qBittorrent or Index publication, install a separate qBittorrent container, mount this template's host Data path read-only at /downloads in that container, expose its authenticated Web API to Mirror, and forward qBittorrent's TCP and UDP peer port. Forward 4444/tcp, 4444/udp, and 5567/tcp if this node should also serve LBRY peers.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Local read-only status page.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent LBRY blobs, plaintext releases, torrents, manifests, SQLite state, and logs.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used in logs.

Config.Name: Enable Web UI
Config.Description: Serve the local status page on container port 5000.

Config.Name: Enable qBittorrent Seed Gate
Config.Description: Add generated torrents to a separately installed qBittorrent client and require active seed state before Index publication.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Web API
Config.Description: HTTP URL for the separate qBittorrent container's authenticated Web API. Use an address reachable from this container.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Username
Config.Description: qBittorrent Web API username. Configure username and password or an API key, never both.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Password
Config.Description: qBittorrent Web API password.

Config.Name: qBittorrent API Key
Config.Description: Optional qBittorrent 5.2 API key beginning with qbt_. Leave username and password empty when using it.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Archive Root
Config.Description: Path where the separate qBittorrent container mounts Mirror's complete data volume read-only.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Ready Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for upload mode and DHT or tracker discovery after torrent injection.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Recheck Interval
Config.Description: Seconds before Mirror expires a green seed receipt and checks qBittorrent again.

Config.Name: Index Tracker Policy Endpoint
Config.Description: Optional public tracker-policy endpoint. Empty derives a sibling route from the Index publication URL. The last valid response is cached.

Config.Name: Index Tracker Policy Timeout
Config.Description: Read timeout in seconds for one conditional tracker-policy request.

Config.Name: Enable Index Publication
Config.Description: POST verified manifests and torrent metainfo to GunCAD Index. Requires a publication endpoint and bearer token.

Config.Name: Index Publication Endpoint
Config.Description: GunCAD Index API v2 torrent publication endpoint.

Config.Name: Index Publication Bearer
Config.Description: High-entropy bearer shared with GunCAD Index. Required only when publication is enabled.

Config.Name: Index Publication Workers
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous SHA-384 publication groups.

Config.Name: Index Publication Timeout
Config.Description: Read timeout in seconds for one publication POST.

Config.Name: Odysee Recovery Fallback
Config.Description: After LBRY peers fail, permit Odysee CDN recovery only when claim ID, descriptor, size, and hash all match.

Config.Name: Odysee SDK Proxy
Config.Description: Public Odysee SDK proxy used for verified recovery fallback.

Config.Name: LBRY Acquisition Workers
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous LBRY stream acquisitions.

Config.Name: Odysee Fallback Workers
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous Odysee CDN fallback downloads.

Config.Name: Finalization Workers
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous plaintext verification and torrent hashing jobs.

Config.Name: Index API v2 Endpoint
Config.Description: API v2 releases endpoint. Add Index search parameters to mirror a filtered catalog.

Config.Name: Blacklisted Channels
Config.Description: Comma-separated channel-handle prefixes. Replace the claim delimiter colon with a hash sign, for example @author#a.

Config.Name: Maximum Payload Size
Config.Description: Largest accepted release in bytes. Zero disables this limit.

Config.Name: Free-space Reserve
Config.Description: Bytes kept free after budgeting for encrypted blobs and assembled plaintext.

Config.Name: API Page Limit
Config.Description: Maximum API pages followed during one scan.

Config.Name: Per-cycle Release Cap
Config.Description: Maximum supported releases processed per scan. Zero disables the cap.

Config.Name: Scan Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between completed Index scans.

Config.Name: Failed-cycle Retry
Config.Description: Seconds before retrying a scan aborted by an operational error.

Config.Name: Download Stall Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds without a decrease in remaining LBRY blobs before stopping a stream.

Config.Name: Torrent Piece Length
Config.Description: BitTorrent v1 piece length in bytes. Must be a power of two and at least 16384.

Config.Name: Operator Tracker Hints
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated HTTP, HTTPS, or UDP announce URLs added to Mirror-owned qBittorrent entries. Outbox and Index torrent files stay trackerless.

Config.Name: LBRY DHT UDP
Config.Description: Forward this port if the node should participate in the LBRY DHT.

Config.Name: LBRY DHT TCP
Config.Description: Forward this port if the node should participate in the LBRY DHT.

Config.Name: LBRY Blob Server
Config.Description: Forward this port if the node should serve cached LBRY blobs.
